# GJTL.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp2,203.0 against Rp1,110.0 (expected total return 105.9%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: derated_compounder_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Autos, components & dealerships.

- The EV/EBITDA leg, 20% of the blend, is computed on an EBITDA of Rp1,951.6bn that the report itself says is about a quarter too low because it carries the vendor depreciation. On the restated FY2025A EBITDA of Rp2,649.0b
- The P/E leg applies 6.72x to FY2025A net profit of Rp1,243.2bn, which is eleven months stale at the valuation date, while the DCF starts at FY2026E. Last-twelve-month net profit is Rp1,418.4bn (FY2025A less 9M2025 plus 9
